newsitem.title: USA: Questions answered on Paris Club entry--Yeltsin.
newsitem.headline: Questions answered on Paris Club entry--Yeltsin.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin said Friday all questions on Russia's entry into the Paris Club of creditor nations had been answered.
"In the Paris Club our delegation has solved all quesions," Yeltsin told reporters before talking to U.S. President Bill Clinton.
Yeltsin is here to take part in nearly all the sessions of the Group of Seven industrial nations leadership summit which officially gets underway later today.
Yeltsin gave no details but Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said: "All questions have been solved on Russia's entry into the Paris Club as a creditor nation."
